title: Dental Caries Examination
defaultText: All teeth are free from carious lesions. No visible discoloration, cavitation, or soft spots detected.

title: Gingival Examination
defaultText: Gingiva is pink, firm, and stippled with no bleeding or swelling. Margins are well contoured.

title: Plaque and Calculus Assessment
defaultText: Minimal plaque present; no visible calculus or deposits on tooth surfaces. Oral hygiene appears satisfactory.

title: Tooth Mobility Test
defaultText: All teeth are firm with no abnormal mobility detected on palpation.

title: Occlusion and Alignment Check
defaultText: Normal Class I occlusion. No crossbite, open bite, or crowding observed. Midlines are coincident.

title: Tooth Vitality Test
defaultText: All tested teeth respond normally to thermal and electric pulp tests. No delayed or absent responses.

title: Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) Examination
defaultText: Smooth opening and closing of mouth. No clicking, deviation, or tenderness on palpation.

title: Oral Mucosa Examination
defaultText: Mucosa appears pink, moist, and intact with no ulcers, lesions, or white/red patches.

title: Tongue Examination
defaultText: Tongue is moist, well-papillated, and freely movable. No coating, fissures, or lesions noted.

title: Periodontal Pocket Measurement
defaultText: Probing depth within normal limits (1-3 mm). No bleeding on probing or attachment loss observed.

title: Radiographic Examination
defaultText: Radiographs show healthy bone levels and intact lamina dura. No evidence of decay or periapical pathology.

title: Attrition, Abrasion and Erosion Check
defaultText: Tooth surfaces are smooth with no pathological wear facets, cervical abrasion, or erosion signs.

title: Restoration and Filling Evaluation
defaultText: Existing restorations (if any) are intact, well contoured, and free from marginal leakage.

title: Discoloration and Stain Assessment
defaultText: Teeth appear clean and naturally shaded. No extrinsic or intrinsic stains observed.

title: Salivary Gland and Flow Assessment
defaultText: Saliva is clear and adequate in quantity. Duct openings are patent with normal flow on palpation.
